announcement_body.headline: The International: Streams, Secret Shop, and More
announcement_body.body: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/aa83bcaaafe7cd4d11a841ec381ec28ccb039d41.png"][/img]It's the final countdown: Players and talent have landed, and all of the pieces are falling into place to make Shanghai the center of the Dota universe for the next two weeks. It's time to finish crafting your fantasy rosters, lock in your first round of predictions, and get ready to tune in because The International 2026 is almost underway.[/p][p]Whether you're looking to watch online, find Dota activities in Shanghai to keep you busy until streams start, or looking for merch you can wear while you're out in Shanghai waiting for games to start, we've got you covered below.[/p][p][/p][h3]The International Group Stage[/h3][p]Sixteen teams have earned the right to compete for the Aegis of Champions in Shanghai, but only eight will face off in the main event. First, they must survive the gauntlet of the Swiss Format Group Stage.[/p][p][url="https://www.dota2.com/esports/ti15/schedule"]Group Stage games begin[/url] on Thursday, August 13 and wrap on Sunday, August 16. In that span, all sixteen teams will play best-of-three matches against other teams with the same overall series record. A fourth series win will earn a team an automatic berth at The International; a fourth loss will result in elimination.[/p][p]By end of play on Saturday, three teams will have secured spots in The International and three teams will have been eliminated. The ten remaining teams will face off in a special elimination round to decide the rest. Every single one of the five series on Sunday will send one team home and the other onward to the main event.[/p][p][/p][h3]The International Main Event[/h3][p]On Thursday, August 20, The International will move to SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center and open the doors to more than ten thousand fans. Four days of intense play through a double-elimination bracket will culminate in the Grand Finals on Sunday, August 23, and only then will the last team stand victorious and raise the Aegis of Champions.[/p][p]Tickets for the event are sold out, but there are tons of ways to watch online — and even a handful of special in-person opportunities available around the city of Shanghai.[/p][p][/p][h3]Tournament Streams[/h3][p]There's nothing quite like watching the best Dota players in the world face off in a live event, and while life and accompanying biological imperatives can make it difficult to try and watch every single game live, here are all the links you'd need to make a glorious attempt.[/p][p][/p][p]Chinese: Twitch: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn"]Stream A[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn_2"]Stream B[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn_3"]Stream C[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn_4"]Stream D[/url]; Steam: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]All Streams[/url]; YouTube: [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]All Streams[/url][/p][p][/p][p]English: Twitch: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti"]Stream A[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_2"]Stream B[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_3"]Stream C[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_4"]Stream D[/url]; Steam: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]All Streams[/url]; YouTube: [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]All Streams[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Russian: Twitch: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_RU"]Stream A[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_ru_2"]Stream B[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_ru_3"]Stream C[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_ru_4"]Stream D[/url]; Steam: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]All Streams[/url]; YouTube: [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]All Streams[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Spanish: Twitch: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_es"]Stream A[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_es_2"]Stream B[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_es_3"]Stream C[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_es_4"]Stream D[/url]; Steam: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]All Streams[/url]; YouTube: [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]All Streams[/url]; Facebook: [url="https://www.facebook.com/dota2"]All Streams[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]Dota 2 Heroes Around Shanghai[/h3][p]From August 13 to August 18, multiple Dota heroes will descend upon iconic landmarks across Shanghai, with a giant Aegis of Champions making its grand debut. Meanwhile, several commercial districts have set up check-in spots for fans to visit and collect souvenirs.[/p][p]Check out the landmark details below or visit [url="https://act.dota2.com.cn/2026/shanghaitour"]Perfect World's Shanghai Dota Tour site[/url] for a handy map.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Dota Hero Landmark Locations[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Wujiaochang Commercial District[/p][/*][*][p]Wujiaochang Guangchang: Aegis of Champions[/p][/*][*][p]Bailian ZX Fun Mall: Queen of Pain, Axe, and Pudge[/p][/*][*][p]Shanghai Wujiaochang Wanda Plaza: Juggernaut[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Lujiazui Super Brand Mall (Aug 12-18): Windranger[/p][/*][*][p]Shanghai EXPO Culture Park (Aug 13-18): Mars and Shadow Fiend[/p][/*][*][p]Taikoo Li Qiantan (Aug 18–24): Aegis of Champions, Drow Ranger, Crystal Maiden, and Juggernaut[/p][/*][*][p]Standard Check-in Spots: Lujiazui 96 Plaza, New bund 31, Shanghai No. 1 Shopping Center, Expo Place[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]The Secret Shops[/h3][p]If you're looking to scope out this year's merchandise offerings, our partner stores are already online for both Chinese and international customers.[/p][list][*][p]For China domestic fans: [url="https://wmsjdj.tmall.com/"]https://wmsjdj.tmall.com/[/url] [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]For fans everywhere else: [url="https://pwrdesports.aliexpress.com/"]https://pwrdesports.aliexpress.com/[/url][/p][/*][/list][p]The Secret Shop will also operate in SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center from August 20 - 23, opening each day at 9:00am and closing after the first break of the last match series of the day. Customers are welcome to purchase directly from onsite cashiers or use the Perfect World app to place an order for pick-up.[/p][p][/p][h3]Community Streams[/h3][p]The strength of Dota has always been its vibrant and passionate community. The International is an expression of that, both the in-person event and the many millions who participate online, those watching and those streaming.[/p][p]Speaking of which: As always, we welcome community streams of the event. There's more detail in [url="https://www.dota2.com/dotatv"]the community stream FAQ[/url], but to summarize: You have a lot of freedom in how to stream your TI commentary the way you and your viewers want as long as your stream is based on DotaTV and your own content, not on someone else's stream (including ours).[/p][p][/p][h3]Wrapping Up[/h3][p]There's obviously a lot going on already, but there's even more info about The International to come. We'll be back soon to provide more details about on-site events, badges, Crimson Witness drops and more as we move closer to the show. Until then, make sure to get those predictions in. We'll see you when groups start.[/p]

announcement_body.headline: Gameplay Patch 7.41e and Summer Scrub
announcement_body.body:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/5179a724ee3987b0b0dab399b9ef2eaba7b2abf4.png[/img]

The International approaches and we've just released an update that includes [url=https://www.dota2.com/newsentry/678505520073540063]predictions, fantasy, supporter bundles[/url], and a chance to prove your skills and win new Immortals and unlock terrains.

But that's not all. Today we're also releasing [url=https://dota2.com/summerscrub2026]patch 7.41e[/url]. Even that's not everything, though. Dota is a complicated game, and while we greatly enjoy the creativity and diligence of the dedicated players who find intricate and absurd bugs, we also like *fixing* those bugs. So today we're also releasing the Summer Scrub, a huge collection of new features as well as fixes for gameplay and content bugs, ranging from Abaddon's taunt to Zeus's Dota Plus challenge.

The list is too long for this post, so we made a whole page just to [url=https://dota2.com/summerscrub2026]list all the changes[/url].

events.event_name: The International: Predictions, Fantasy, and Supporter Bundles

announcement_body.headline: The International: Predictions, Fantasy, and Supporter Bundles
announcement_body.body:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/5c825b3d35627bfc4276c013745aa6fd4de935ea.png[/img]

Nearly a year has passed since Team Falcons hoisted the Aegis of Champions as the final team standing in Hamburg. But that was last year's story, and the time has come to turn our thoughts to Shanghai and the crop of competitors who vie to write the tale of [i]this[/i] year. All of their battles have brought them to the precipice. The International is just two weeks away.

After a decisive month of intense qualifiers, dominant performances from prior champions, and upset victories from up-and-comers, all sixteen teams have earned their invitations to this year's International.

Now it's time for us to extend an invitation to you.

We've just released an update featuring this year's TI-themed activities and item bundles. Not sure what that means? Keep reading for a handy guide to all the different ways to participate so you can find the content that's most interesting to you.

[list][*][b]I want to directly support my favorite teams and personalities.[/b][/list]
With supporter bundles for all sixteen teams and more than a hundred participating event talent, there's never been a better time to support your favorites. In addition to the four primary event languages, this year we're also offering community bundles for WXC Co. (Filipino), NS_ART (Brazilian Portuguese), and Maincast (Ukrainian). 50% of sales from supporter bundles (teams, talent, and community broadcasts) goes directly to the team or talent and 30% goes to the tournament prize pool.

[list][*][b]I want to show off that I supported my favorite team.[/b][/list]
Purchasing team supporter bundles of various levels will grant all kinds of things: custom sprays, a special badge for your health bar, custom team emoticons, custom chat wheel lines, and — new this year as a part of the Gold tier — a global effigy. This new building will replace your regular effigy through the end of September, allowing you to show your team support right in your base. Not supportive enough? You can purchase additional supporter levels that will upgrade the appearance of your effigy, including custom effects.

[list][*][b]I'm right about everything. Help me prove it.[/b][/list]
Predictions are back: How will the Swiss matches shake out? What about the bracket? Fun fact: Exactly zero have ever gotten the full Swiss stage results correct. Will you be the first this year? Not if you don't get your guesses in before the first match starts (10am CST, Thursday 8/13).

[list][*][b]I'm a huge fan of my favorite team but also I dislike all of their choices and wish I was in charge.[/b][/list]
We've got a new take on fantasy this year. We've introduced a new customization point: You. You're the coach, and can now assign custom modifiers to yourself that influence your whole team. We've also updated prefixes, suffixes, and the player drafting rules. You'll draft your perfect team in (mostly) pairs: both supports from one team, the safelaner and offlaner from one team, and then your favorite midlaner. 

[list][*][b]I am a Dota player and I'm already assuming I'll be the best at everything. What do I win?[/b][/list]
Like last year, awards will be granted to participating players based on their performance relative to everyone else. The Tyrian Regalia treasure is making a royal return with five refashioned Immortal items, exclusively available to the top performing players. New this year is the Terrain Token, which will allow winners to choose one of six returning custom terrains, including Reef's Edge and Immortal Gardens. Look for more information, including reward tiers and lots of details, in the Rewards section of the main Dota 2 menu.

[list][*][b]All of this is great but I did my predictions and my fantasy and supported the teams and talent already. What do I do [i]now[/i]?[/b][/list]
Good news for you: We also just shipped a new gameplay patch along with a ton of content fixes. Check out the [url=https://dota2.com/summerscrub2026]Summer Scrub 2026[/url] page for more details.
